title: A Neuro-Immune Score Defines a Stromal-Neural and Immune-Segregated Microenvironment Associated with Poor Prognosis in Colorectal Cancer.
snippet: Colorectal cancer progression and therapeutic response are determined not only by tumor-intrinsic programs but also by neural, stromal, and immune components of the tumor microenvironment.
